headline: Social Work Unit Supervisor
summary: Social work supervisor with eleven years in child welfare and family services in Capiz. I lead a unit of eight social workers, supervise field practicum students, and make sure our work follows social welfare law, ethics and accreditation standards. I still carry complex clinical cases and handle ethical dilemmas with the team.
highlights: Led the unit through full accreditation as a social welfare agency with no major findings.
Set up a clinical supervision schedule that cut social worker turnover from four resignations a year to one.
Supervised 30 social work practicum students from three universities.
skills: Social counselling and clinical social work
Policy input to the provincial board

experience.title: Social Work Unit Supervisor

bullets: Supervise eight social workers covering child protection, adoption and family support.
Review case plans weekly and sign off on court and adoption reports.
Represent the foundation in provincial child-protection meetings and comment on draft ordinances.
